protocol.outcome: Field-average reported maize grain yield in kg/ha; source does not report reference moisture, so no dry-grain conversion is claimed.
protocol.split: 27 train, 9 calibration, 10 locked spatial-test fields; the same partition is reused for every issue date.
protocol.availabilityRule: Only satellite acquisitions dated at least five days before an issue date are eligible. This is a conservative latency scenario; exact historical source-publication timestamps are unavailable.
protocol.satelliteCollection: Earth Search public Sentinel-2 L2A COGs, queried with the same field geometry; at most 12 dates are sampled uniformly from scenes available by each issue cutoff. SCL classes 4 and 5 define clear vegetation/bare-soil pixels; summaries require at least 10 usable field pixels and at least 20% clear coverage.
predictorAblations: Train-set mean yield baseline; used for fields lacking usable imagery.
NDVI only: latest usable observation, mean to date, and maximum to date, evaluated as separate one-feature ridge models.
EVI only: latest usable observation, mean to date, and maximum to date, evaluated as separate one-feature ridge models.
NDVI + EVI: latest usable values and season-to-date means, one fixed four-feature ridge model.
SoilGrids only: pH, SOC, total N, CEC, bulk density, sand, silt and clay sampled at each field's interior point at 250 m native support; one fixed regularized model.
Sentinel NDVI/EVI + SoilGrids: the same fixed satellite summaries plus the same eight soil covariates.
Existing ground-measured LAI model from the locked Ghana benchmark, as an upper-quality comparator that is not operationally available from Sentinel.
Previous-year HarvestStat admin1 maize yield prior (2020, spatially uniform within Northern and Savannah); retrospective local field comparison, not a within-region parcel downscaling.
protocol.fit: Median imputation and standardization are fitted on the training subset only; Ridge alpha=1 fixed before test evaluation. No hyperparameter selection or feature selection on calibration/test fields. Conformal interval uses calibration fields only.
protocol.activationGate: This n=10 held-out set can falsify a candidate but cannot establish the user's 70/100 parcel target. Activation requires at least 100 independent field forecasts across multiple held-out seasons and sites, with at least 70% within ±20%, alongside the project's MAE/bias and interval-coverage gates.
limitations: Single north-Ghana area and one 2021 season; no prospective or cross-season validation.
Yield reference is quadrat-based and reported moisture is unspecified.
Five-day availability lag is a sensitivity assumption, not a verified historical publication timestamp.
This experiment evaluates a satellite yield covariate on known field polygons; it does not test automated field-boundary or crop-type detection.
The polygon-file soil/management attributes are incomplete/misaligned and are excluded. SoilGrids is a 250 m map prediction, not a field test; total N is not plant-available N.
protocol.selectionRule: Report every predeclared ablation and every issue date. The locked test set is not used to choose a winning variant or activate production.
protocol.confirmationStatus: The test split was already inspected in the initial partial-coverage run. The complete-coverage rerun is exploratory and is not a blind confirmatory evaluation.
protocol.regionalDownscalingDecision: A yield-weighted relative-score redistribution was not fit: the available 46 research polygons are a selected sample, not the complete maize area of Northern/Savannah, so their area-weighted denominator cannot conserve the published regional yield without using an unsupported crop mask.
protocol.soilHydraulicProfileDecision: The six modeled available-water layers are present for all 46 fields (27 train, 9 calibration, 10 test) and were evaluated in secondary exploratory ablations. The profile alone had MAE 704 kg/ha and 2/10 held-out fields within ±20%; soil scalars plus profile had MAE 838 kg/ha and 1/10; Sentinel amplitude plus profile ranged 509-825 kg/ha and 2-3/10 across issue dates; trajectory plus all 18 soil features had MAE 982-1252 kg/ha and 1-3/10. These non-blind retrospective results do not establish a stable gain or justify production use.

analysisStatus: Exploratory complete-coverage rerun. The same held-out fields were already inspected in an earlier partial-coverage run; these results are not a blind confirmatory evaluation and are not used to select or activate a production model.

sentinel.sourceProvider: Earth Search STAC and public Sentinel-2 COGs; research fallback because Digital Earth Africa STAC returned HTTP 403 in this runner.
sentinel.temporalCutoffRule: Per issue date, acquisitions no later than issue date minus five days; five days is a conservative availability-lag assumption, not a verified historical publication timestamp.
sentinel.geometryRepair: Original polygons that passed the project validator are reused byte-for-byte; only invalid research polygons are repaired with GDAL/OGR MakeValid. Production validation is unchanged. All repaired components and holes are sampled.

soil.soilSource: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0 WCS; 250 m predictive maps, not field assays; total N is not plant-available N.
soil.spatialSupport: SoilGrids values sampled at an interior point of the repaired public study polygon (GDAL MakeValid + ST_PointOnSurface); one modelled 250 m cell may cover several nearby fields.
soil.geometryRepair: Research-only geometry repair; source polygons and application parcel validation are unchanged.
soil.split: Reused the locked field-ID SHA256 split from the Ghana canopy benchmark.

validationScope: Retrospective spatial holdout within one 2021 Ghana study area; the training fields' same-season yield labels were not available at those historical issue dates. This is not a prospective forecast validation.
privacyNote: Aggregate metrics only. Row-level field identifiers, coordinates, observed yields, and individual predictions are intentionally omitted.
